verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists a built-in "Conversational meeting assistant", and the product does AI work itself: summaries, action items and automatic CRM field updates. That is the product's own in-app AI, but no documentation shows users delegating arbitrary tasks to it. The MCP server and Claude connector expose Fathom data to external assistants, which is not a built-in assistant, so they are not credited. missing for 10: documentation of what the conversational assistant can do, evidence of task delegation or agentic actions inside the product, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically
